label: TP
reason: User input flows directly to a tainted format string sink via response.getWriter().format(bar, ...). The sanitize function in doSomething only removes the last character of the input, which does not prevent arbitrary format specifiers (e.g., "%n", "%%") from being passed to the vulnerable format call, enabling XSS.

evidence.note: Param sanitized by substring then used in tainted format string sink
